_comment: What this gate emits against each tree here. Machine-readable because prose in GATE.md is not a declaration: a stated count nothing checks drifts the moment a case is added.

cases: target `test-fast` type-checks Go but does not list `stamp` as a prerequisite
job `go` reaches the Go toolchain without going through make, and never runs make stamp or make warm
job `lint` generates the source AFTER compiling it
